## Introduction

AutoJs4 is a JavaScript automation tool for Android with accessibility service support. This repository is based on the final open-source Auto.js release `4.1.1 Alpha2` (build `461`), preserving its source and applying the updates needed to build and run it on recent Android versions.

Auto.js was first released by [hyb1996](https://github.com/hyb1996) on `2017/01/27`, and maintenance ended on `2020/03/13`. AutoJs4 began development from that release on `2023/04/11` and remains free and open source.

[Download AutoJs4](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4/releases) / [Report an issue](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4/issues) / [In-app Simplified Chinese release history](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4/blob/master/app/src/main/assets/doc/CHANGELOG.md).

## Related projects

[AutoJs4](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4) is the behavioral baseline of [AutoJs6](http://project.autojs6.com): apart from a few specific cases, scripts that run correctly on AutoJs4 should produce exactly the same effects and results on AutoJs6.

[AutoJs4-Documentation](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4-Documentation) preserves the applicable open-source Auto.js `4.1.0` documentation and serves as the reference baseline of [AutoJs6-Documentation](http://docs-project.autojs6.com). The application version `4.1.1 Alpha2` and documentation version `4.1.0` are distinct labels.

[AutoJs6-Plugin-AutoJs4-Runtime](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-Plugin-AutoJs4-Runtime) embeds the AutoJs4 engine modules `autojs`, `common`, and `automator` through a Git submodule and runs scripts in a separate process. "Run with AutoJs4" in the AutoJs6 file manager enables result comparisons without installing AutoJs4 separately.

[AutoJs6](http://project.autojs6.com) continues development from Auto.js. [AutoJs6-Documentation](http://docs-project.autojs6.com) supplies the shared content source for its [online documentation](https://docs.autojs6.com) and offline documentation plugin.

## Features

- JavaScript IDE with code completion, variable renaming, and code formatting.
- Accessibility automation and selector APIs to find and traverse controls, inspect information, and perform actions, similar to UiAutomator.
- Floating controls for recording and running scripts, viewing package and activity names, and inspecting layout hierarchies and control bounds.
- Script recording and playback, screen capture and saving, image color search, and image matching.
- E4X interfaces and packaging scripts or projects as APK files.
- Root-enabled extensions for taps, swipes, recording, and Shell commands.
- Tasker plugin support and desktop development through VSCode with [AutoJs4-VSCode-Extension](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4-VSCode-Extension).

## Requirements

Android 4.4 (API 19, KITKAT) or later. See [project-versions.json](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4/blob/master/project-versions.json) for the current application version and build parameters.

## Multilingual documentation

Edit the language JSON and templates in `.readme/` and `.changelog/`, then regenerate the documents. Do not edit generated Markdown directly. The root README uses Simplified Chinese. These commands require Python 3.10 or newer without extra Python packages; Windows can use `py` instead of `python`. `--check` validates languages, fields, historical versions and dates, punctuation, and generated files without writing. CI runs the same check.

```shell
python .python/generate_markdown.py
python .python/generate_markdown.py --check
```
